name: PandorasNodes404 transferFrom allowance underflow
summary: PandorasNodes404, an ERC-404 clone compiled with Solidity 0.7, subtracted the amount from the caller's allowance without overflow checks, so transferFrom with no allowance wrapped instead of reverting. The attacker pulled the token out of its Uniswap pair, synced and swapped for the pair's WETH, 11 minutes after deployment.
notes: Loss is the pair's WETH; its PandorasNodes404 is valued at nothing (rule 12).
